 Order

This Criminal Original Petition is filed seeking to call for the records relating to the First Information Report in Crime No.19 of 2025 pending investigation on the file of the 1st respondent and quash the same.

2.The case of the prosecution is that the petitioners/accused, who are running a real estate business under the name and style of Velocity Developers and Blossoms Assets & Developers, cheated the de facto complainant by failing to execute a sale deed after receiving the total consideration of Rs.28,00,000/- in connection with the sale of a property.
3.Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that a matter of a commercial nature has been falsely projected as a case of cheating.

He would also submit that the respondent/de facto complainant, instead of filing a suit for specific performance, filed a false complaint, based on which, the First Information Report was registered for the offences under Sections 120(B), 420 and 506(i) IPC.
4.Learned Additional Public Prosecutor would submit that the petitioners induced the de facto complainant to pay a total sum of Rs.28,00,000/-, but failed to execute the sale deed.

He would further submit https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 26/02/2026 04:10:23 pm ) that the petitioners are habitual offenders and similar cases are pending against them at Madurai CCB and that they were previously arrested and released on bail and the investigation is at a crucial/nascent stage.

5.Learned counsel appearing for the second respondent/de facto complainant would submit that the second respondent is a Marine Engineer, who believed the advertisement issued by the petitioners promoting their land and based on this belief, the de facto complainant had deposited a sum of Rs.28,00,000/-.

However, the petitioners/accused have cheated the de facto complainant and other similar cases are pending against them.
6.In view of the fact that the investigation is at a crucial/nascent stage
, this Court is not inclined to quash the proceedings especially since the petitioners have allegedly cheated three other persons in a similar manner in addition to the de facto complainant.
7.Accordingly, the above Criminal Original petition is dismissed.
Consequently, connected criminal miscellaneous petition is closed.
